title: SO-1.04 Dispatch events: a requested action, an accepted dispatch, an observed execution and a verified outcome stay apart
request: Closes G-SO-04 (addendum 3, review row 3). Source: the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0) and its review table (issuecomment-6534383323); owner request of 31 Oct 2026 that every aspect be decomposed in the WBS and built into contracts (t531u). The addendum names recommendations that become contracts on acceptance; this contract is the design-record stage, so it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. Depends on contracts: SO-05-B, SO-05-D, SO-08-A.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Define one adapter contract with declared capabilities, identity, session discovery, dispatch, progress/result reporting, checkpointing, cancellation semantics and recovery.
Keep provider-specific behaviour inside adapters; the planner and coordinator must consume capability declarations rather than provider-specific conditionals.
Distinguish a requested action, an accepted dispatch, an observed execution and a verified outcome in the event history.
Never report successful completion merely because a provider returned a success-shaped response.
